purpose: Canonical SUITE PIN for the Consensus opencode shim: the upstream checkout our compatibility suite is executed against, the transport adaptation applied to it, and the pristine hash of every file the runner consumes. Consumed by scripts/test-opencode-upstream.sh (which refuses to run if any hash drifts) and pinned in code by internal/chronicle/opencode_upstream_runner_test.go. The PROTOCOL pin (which published OpenAPI document our declared surface is compared against) is a separate file, specs/openapi/opencode-pin.yaml; see docs/opencode-upstream-refresh-procedure.md for why there are two.

transport.note: The adapter is transport-only: it must not edit an upstream assertion or a test registration, and scripts/test-opencode-upstream.sh --self-test enforces that. The preload redirects loopback/test-host fetches to the shim under test; it deliberately does not redirect /v1/* (the suites' own LLM fixture transport).

enforced_by: scripts/test-opencode-upstream.sh --self-test (runner constants vs this file; adapter may not touch upstream assertions)
scripts/test-opencode-upstream.sh (every hash above is verified against a pristine checkout BEFORE the adapter is applied)
consistency.note: This file records the pin the suite is executed against; a change here without a matching change in the runner constants and the Go test is a red build by design.

suites.transport: self-contained SDK contract; no live HTTP transport
